testCases.label: Reverses a simple 3-letter string
testCases.description: Verifies that the reverse method returns 'cba' when given the input 'abc'.

testCases.label: Reverses a palindrome string
testCases.description: Verifies that the reverse method returns the same value 'racecar' when given the palindrome 'racecar'.

testCases.label: Reverses a single-character string
testCases.description: Verifies that the reverse method returns 'f' when given the single-character string 'f'.

testCases.label: Reverses an empty string
testCases.description: Verifies that the reverse method returns an empty string when given an empty string as input.

testCases.label: Reverses a longer word
testCases.description: Verifies that the reverse method returns 'wollip' when given the input 'pillow'.
